title: Tester Acceptance Equals CSP Value
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, Boolean input word $w$ of length $m+2$, and Boolean proof word $q$ of length $m+1$, the uniform string tester's acceptance equals the value of its associated constraint satisfaction instance under the assignment given by $w$ and $q$; that value is the fraction of constraints satisfied, counted with their multiplicities.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $m+2$
$q$ is a Boolean proof word of length $m+1$
